title: CLOSE THE DECISION LOOP
goal: End the reopened choice by separating intended effect from actual result and finishing one active piece.

steps.text: Say one sentence aloud.
Describe the difference between the intended effect and what really happened.
Pin down which questions can stay parked.
Complete one finishable piece of the active task.
Say where this loop can stop.

win: Parked questions remained parked, one task piece was completed, and you named exactly where to stop.
mindBend: A decision loop stays open when intention and outcome are judged as one thing. Separating them reveals what can change.
formulaFlow: Make Cue → Unmix Story → Park Rest → Begin Now → Set Ending

title: FACT QUICK-TURN
goal: Keep uncertainty separate from the visible result instead of letting each stand in for the other.

steps.text: Say the uncertain piece.
State the visible result a single time.

win: The unknown part and the observable outcome were each stated once without being fused.
mindBend: Uncertainty about one piece does not erase evidence from another. The mind often makes 'not fully known' mean 'nothing is known.'
formulaFlow: Name Unknown → Take Stock
